name: Hydrochloric acid
description: Used for neutralization and generating gases.

name: Sulfuric acid
description: Used as a strong catalyst and dehydrating agent.

name: Nitric acid
description: Used for oxidizing reactions and metal testing.

name: Acetic acid
description: Used as a weak acid for organic chemistry basics.

name: Sodium hydroxide
description: Used for saponification and cation precipitation tests.

name: Ammonia solution
description: Used for complex ions and weak base reactions.

name: Calcium hydroxide
description: Commonly called limewater, used to test for carbon dioxide gas.

name: Sodium carbonate
description: Used for precipitation and water softening demonstrations.

name: Sodium bicarbonate
description: Baking soda, used for gas production and neutralizing acid spills.

name: Copper(II) sulfate
description: Used for electrolysis and testing for water (anhydrous form).

name: Sodium chloride
description: Standard salt for solubility and conductivity experiments.

name: Potassium iodide
description: Used to test for oxidizers and starch (when mixed with iodine).

name: Lead(II) nitrate
description: Used to demonstrate dramatic precipitation reactions.

name: Silver nitrate
description: Used as a highly sensitive reagent to test for halide ions.

name: Barium chloride
description: Used specifically to test for sulfate ions.

name: Calcium chloride
description: Used as a drying agent and for calcium ion tests.

name: Iron(III) chloride
description: Used to test for phenols and to demonstrate hydrolysis.

name: Magnesium sulfate
description: Used in solubility and crystallization studies.

name: Zinc sulfate
description: Used in building galvanic/voltaic chemical cells.

name: Potassium permanganate
description: A powerful self-indicating oxidizing agent.

name: Hydrogen peroxide
description: Used to demonstrate decomposition and oxygen production.

name: Magnesium ribbon
description: Used for combustion and displacement reactions.

name: Zinc granules
description: Used with acids to produce hydrogen gas.

name: Iron filings
description: Used for magnetism and displacement experiments.

name: Copper turnings
description: Used to demonstrate low metal reactivity.

name: Phenolphthalein
description: Turns bright pink in bases; crucial for titrations.

name: Methyl orange
description: Changes color in lower pH ranges.

name: Litmus solution/paper
description: Quick test for general acidity or alkalinity.

name: Universal indicator
description: Provides a full spectrum color match for pH values 1–14.

name: Distilled water
description: The universal solvent for preparing all aqueous solutions.

name: Ethanol
description: Used as an organic solvent and for fuel in burners.

name: Iodine solution
description: Used as a starch indicator in biology and chemistry.

name: Manganese(IV) oxide
description: Used as a catalyst to speed up peroxide decomposition.

name: Cobalt(II) chloride paper
description: Changes from blue to pink to detect the presence of moisture.

name: Lime water (Ca(OH)2 aq)
description: Turns cloudy when carbon dioxide is bubbled through it.
